name: Maison Margiela
note: Mostly unisex: nearly the whole Replica range is labelled for women and men, so both tabs overlap a lot. Lipstick On and Flower Market are women's, as were the first Replica launches (Beach Walk, Funfair Evening). By the Fireplace and Jazz Club are by far the most rated. Replica scents are Eau de Toilette, so expect moderate longevity.
